---
title: "panzoom match: auto"
description: "With `match: auto`, panzoom picks the images itself, and none are marked."
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
filters:
  - path: ../../_filters/show-source.lua
    at: pre-ast
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
  hint: false
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: fade
  desc-position: right
  loop: true
  css-class: my-lb
---

## About

With `match: auto`, panzoom takes every image lightbox would take
on its own, so no image needs marking. The markup is the same as in
[`a-lightbox`](a-lightbox.html), which has no panzoom. Compare each case
with the same number there.

```yaml
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
lightbox:
  match: auto
```

## 1. Single image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image with a description and `desc-position="left"`. It opens in
panzoom, with the description below the caption, since panzoom has no
`desc-position`.

```{.markdown .show-source}
![Beach in Chilmark](../../images/mv-0.jpg){description="Chilmark has _some_ of the best beaches. **credit:** [Chilmark Beach](https://unsplash.com/photos/VBDJGOMCwps)" desc-position="left"}
```

## 2. Gallery in a layout {#c2 expect-open="panzoom"}

Three images in a custom layout, joined by `group`. They open in panzoom as
a three-image gallery.

```{.markdown .show-source}
::: {layout="[[1, 1], [1]]"}
![Aquinnah](../../images/mv-1.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="The waves break off Aquinnah."}

![Oak Bluffs](../../images/mv-3.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Gingerbread cottages."}

![Vineyard lighthouse](../../images/mv-2.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Edgartown Lighthouse."}
:::
```

## 3. Math {#c3 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image with math in its caption and description. It opens in
panzoom with both typeset.

```{.markdown .show-source}
![Caption with math $e^{i\pi}+1=0$](../../images/mv-4.jpg){description="Description with math $\\int_0^1 x^2\\,dx = 1/3$"}
```

## 4. Markdown subfigures {#c4 expect-open="panzoom"}

Two markdown subfigures, the first cross-referenced in the caption. They
open in panzoom as a two-image gallery.

```{.markdown .show-source}
::: {#fig-md-sub layout-ncol=2}
![Sub A](../../images/mv-1.jpg){#fig-md-a}

![Sub B](../../images/mv-2.jpg){#fig-md-b}

Two markdown subfigures (see @fig-md-a).
:::
```

## 5. R subfigures {#c5 expect-open="panzoom"}

Two subfigures from one R cell. They open in panzoom as a two-image gallery.

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-sub
#| fig-cap: "Two R subfigures."
#| fig-subcap: ["Pressure", "Cars"]
#| layout-ncol: 2

plot(pressure)
plot(cars)
```

## 6. Cell options {#c6 expect-open="glightbox"}

Two R cells with lightbox options for a group and a description. Asking for
lightbox keeps them out of panzoom, so they open in lightbox as a two-image
gallery.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Simple demo R plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: This is 1 to 10 plot

plot(1:10, rnorm(10))
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Plot about cars data
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: We see our cars data above

plot(cars)
```

## 7. Two plots in one cell {#c7 expect-open="glightbox"}

One R cell with two plots and lightbox options. They open in lightbox as a
two-image gallery.

```{r}
#| fig-cap:
#|   - Caption for first plot
#|   - Caption for second plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: cars
#|   description:
#|     - Description for first graph
#|     - Description for second graph

plot(mtcars)
plot(cars)
```

## 8. Opt-out {#c8 expect-open="nothing"}

An R cell with `lightbox: false`. Clicking it does nothing.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: mtcars, lightbox false
#| lightbox: false

plot(mtcars)
```

## 9. Image in a link {#c9 expect-open="nothing"}

An image inside a link. Quarto turns it into a figure and drops the link,
and `match: auto` skips it, as lightbox does, so clicking it does nothing.

```{.markdown .show-source}
[![Linked image](../../images/mv-4.jpg){width=30%}](https://quarto.org)
```

## 10. Margin image {#c10 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image in the margin. It opens in panzoom.

```{.markdown .show-source}
![Margin image](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.column-margin}
```

## 11. Inline image {#c11 expect-open="nothing"}

An image inside a sentence. `match: auto` skips inline images, as lightbox
does, so clicking it does nothing.

```{.markdown .show-source}
Some text with an inline image ![](../../images/mv-2.jpg){width=60px} in the middle.
```

## 12. Plain R figure {#c12 expect-open="panzoom"}

A cross-referenced R figure with no options. It opens in panzoom.

```{r}
#| label: fig-plain
#| fig-cap: A plain cross-referenced R figure.

image(volcano)
```
